001package iscteiul.ista.battleship;
002import java.util.ArrayList;
003import java.util.Iterator;
004import java.util.List;
005/**
006 * Represents a ship in the Battleship game.
007 *
008 * <p>A ship has a category, a bearing (orientation), an initial position,
009 * and a collection of positions that it occupies on the board.</p>
010 *
011 * <p>This class provides common functionality shared by all types of ships,
012 * such as checking whether the ship is still floating, determining its
013 * boundaries, checking occupied positions, detecting nearby ships, and
014 * processing shots.</p>
015 */
016
017
018public abstract class Ship implements IShip {
019
020    private static final String GALEAO = "galeao";
021    private static final String FRAGATA = "fragata";
022    private static final String NAU = "nau";
023    private static final String CARAVELA = "caravela";
024    private static final String BARCA = "barca";
025
026    /**
027     * Creates a ship of the specified type.
028     *
029     * @param shipKind the type of ship to create
030     * @param bearing the orientation of the ship
031     * @param pos the initial position of the ship
032     * @return a new ship corresponding to {@code shipKind}, or {@code null}
033     *         if the specified type is unknown
034     */
035    static Ship buildShip(String shipKind, Compass bearing, Position pos) {
036        Ship s;
037        switch (shipKind) {
038            case BARCA:
039                s = new Barge(bearing, pos);
040                break;
041            case CARAVELA:
042                s = new Caravel(bearing, pos);
043                break;
044            case NAU:
045                s = new Carrack(bearing, pos);
046                break;
047            case FRAGATA:
048                s = new Frigate(bearing, pos);
049                break;
050            case GALEAO:
051                s = new Galleon(bearing, pos);
052                break;
053            default:
054                s = null;
055        }
056        return s;
057    }
058
059    /** The category/type of the ship. */
060    private String category;
061
062    /** The orientation of the ship. */
063    private Compass bearing;
064
065    /** The initial position of the ship. */
066    private IPosition pos;
067
068    /** The positions occupied by the ship. */
069    protected List<IPosition> positions;
070
071    /**
072     * Constructs a ship.
073     *
074     * @param category the category/type of the ship
075     * @param bearing the orientation of the ship
076     * @param pos the initial position of the ship
077     * @throws AssertionError if {@code bearing} or {@code pos} is {@code null}
078     */
079    public Ship(String category, Compass bearing, IPosition pos) {
080        assert bearing != null;
081        assert pos != null;
082
083        this.category = category;
084        this.bearing = bearing;
085        this.pos = pos;
086        positions = new ArrayList<>();
087    }
088
089    /**
090     * Returns the category of this ship.
091     *
092     * @return the ship category
093     */
094    @Override
095    public String getCategory() {
096        return category;
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * Returns the positions occupied by this ship.
101     *
102     * @return the list of positions occupied by the ship
103     */
104    public List<IPosition> getPositions() {
105        return positions;
106    }
107
108    /**
109     * Returns the initial position of this ship.
110     *
111     * @return the initial position
112     */
113    @Override
114    public IPosition getPosition() {
115        return pos;
116    }
117
118    /**
119     * Returns the bearing (orientation) of this ship.
120     *
121     * @return the ship bearing
122     */
123    @Override
124    public Compass getBearing() {
125        return bearing;
126    }
127
128    /**
129     * Determines whether the ship is still floating.
130     *
131     * <p>A ship is considered to be floating if at least one of its
132     * positions has not been hit.</p>
133     *
134     * @return {@code true} if at least one position has not been hit;
135     *         {@code false} otherwise
136     */
137    @Override
138    public boolean stillFloating() {
139        for (int i = 0; i < getSize(); i++)
140            if (!getPositions().get(i).isHit())
141                return true;
142        return false;
143    }
144
145    /**
146     * Returns the row of the topmost position occupied by the ship.
147     *
148     * @return the smallest row index occupied by the ship
149     */
150    @Override
151    public int getTopMostPos() {
152        int top = getPositions().get(0).getRow();
153        for (int i = 1; i < getSize(); i++)
154            if (getPositions().get(i).getRow() < top)
155                top = getPositions().get(i).getRow();
156        return top;
157    }
158
159    /**
160     * Returns the row of the bottommost position occupied by the ship.
161     *
162     * @return the largest row index occupied by the ship
163     */
164    @Override
165    public int getBottomMostPos() {
166        int bottom = getPositions().get(0).getRow();
167        for (int i = 1; i < getSize(); i++)
168            if (getPositions().get(i).getRow() > bottom)
169                bottom = getPositions().get(i).getRow();
170        return bottom;
171    }
172
173    /**
174     * Returns the column of the leftmost position occupied by the ship.
175     *
176     * @return the smallest column index occupied by the ship
177     */
178    @Override
179    public int getLeftMostPos() {
180        int left = getPositions().get(0).getColumn();
181        for (int i = 1; i < getSize(); i++)
182            if (getPositions().get(i).getColumn() < left)
183                left = getPositions().get(i).getColumn();
184        return left;
185    }
186
187    /**
188     * Returns the column of the rightmost position occupied by the ship.
189     *
190     * @return the largest column index occupied by the ship
191     */
192    @Override
193    public int getRightMostPos() {
194        int right = getPositions().get(0).getColumn();
195        for (int i = 1; i < getSize(); i++)
196            if (getPositions().get(i).getColumn() > right)
197                right = getPositions().get(i).getColumn();
198        return right;
199    }
200
201    /**
202     * Determines whether this ship occupies the specified position.
203     *
204     * @param pos the position to check
205     * @return {@code true} if this ship occupies {@code pos};
206     *         {@code false} otherwise
207     * @throws AssertionError if {@code pos} is {@code null}
208     */
209    @Override
210    public boolean occupies(IPosition pos) {
211        assert pos != null;
212
213        for (int i = 0; i < getSize(); i++)
214            if (getPositions().get(i).equals(pos))
215                return true;
216        return false;
217    }
218
219    /**
220     * Determines whether this ship is too close to another ship.
221     *
222     * <p>The ships are considered too close if any position occupied by
223     * the other ship is adjacent to one of this ship's positions.</p>
224     *
225     * @param other the other ship to check
226     * @return {@code true} if the ships are too close;
227     *         {@code false} otherwise
228     * @throws AssertionError if {@code other} is {@code null}
229     */
230    @Override
231    public boolean tooCloseTo(IShip other) {
232        assert other != null;
233
234        Iterator<IPosition> otherPos = other.getPositions().iterator();
235        while (otherPos.hasNext())
236            if (tooCloseTo(otherPos.next()))
237                return true;
238
239        return false;
240    }
241
242    /**
243     * Determines whether this ship is too close to the specified position.
244     *
245     * @param pos the position to check
246     * @return {@code true} if the position is adjacent to any position
247     *         occupied by this ship; {@code false} otherwise
248     */
249    @Override
250    public boolean tooCloseTo(IPosition pos) {
251        for (int i = 0; i < this.getSize(); i++)
252            if (getPositions().get(i).isAdjacentTo(pos))
253                return true;
254        return false;
255    }
256
257    /**
258     * Shoots at the specified position.
259     *
260     * <p>If the specified position is occupied by this ship, that position
261     * is marked as hit.</p>
262     *
263     * @param pos the position at which to shoot
264     * @throws AssertionError if {@code pos} is {@code null}
265     */
266    @Override
267    public void shoot(IPosition pos) {
268        assert pos != null;
269
270        for (IPosition position : getPositions()) {
271            if (position.equals(pos))
272                position.shoot();
273        }
274    }
275
276    /**
277     * Returns a string representation of this ship.
278     *
279     * @return a string containing the ship category, bearing and position
280     */
281    @Override
282    public String toString() {
283        return "[" + category + " " + bearing + " " + pos + "]";
284    }
285}
